name: Four Seasons Doha, The Pearl-Qatar
positioning: Seaside apartment-style Four Seasons resort on The Pearl-Qatar island in Doha, with a private beach
best_for: Families wanting apartments with full kitchens and a kids' club
Travelers who want a beach and pools in Doha

facts.text: The address is Porto Arabia Drive 127, The Pearl-Qatar, Doha.
The Pearl-Qatar is a man-made island built on an ancient pearl diving site.
The hotel has a private beach.
There is a sloped-entrance pool for families.
The indoor pool is a 25-metre heated pool.
The Fitness Centre is open 24 hours.
The spa has four treatment rooms.
The Kids For All Seasons program welcomes ages 4 to 12.

highlights.text: Chicago Rare is featured in the Michelin Guide 2025.
Spuntino serves Southern Italian cuisine from breakfast through dinner.
Loulou, the name of the spa, is the Arabic word for pearl.
The apartments and residences feature full kitchens.
Duchess is a tea lounge with a sea view.
Premium Wi-Fi is a complimentary service.

considerations.text: The hotel is a 20-minute drive to Doha's West Bay business centre.
Souq Waqif is 35 minutes from the hotel.
WhataHotel notes the island location may require transportation to reach central Doha attractions.
The outdoor pool and private beach are open 6:00 am to 9:00 pm.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
